question: Does the frozen complement-optimized H3 axis beat difference-in-means outside its scalar answer-margin target, or did the fit exploit that target and signed averaging?

searched: AGENT_BOARD.md constrained DAS / difference in means / complement
prior_art_search.relation: Frozen-axis target audit not previously run. The parent reports signed mean answer-margin fractions only; it does not report held-out rowwise squared loss or full-vocabulary effect fidelity.

frozen_design.axes: the stored rank-1 constrained-DAS axis and a difference-in-means axis recomputed only from the original 16 fit rows
frozen_design.evaluation_rows: the original 16 held-out A1 rows and all 32 A2 rows; no refitting
frozen_design.scalar_metrics: per-row donor-normalized subspace match error and complement effect; report mean signed, mean absolute, RMS, p90 absolute, and the exact parent joint squared objective
frozen_design.vector_metrics: center each row's complete vocabulary-logit effect across vocabulary; compare subspace versus exact-H3 match and complement versus native using per-row RMS normalized by the exact-H3 RMS
frozen_design.interventions: base, exact H3, constrained-DAS H3 axis, its complement, DIM H3 axis, and its complement

opposing_predictions.genuine_causal_quotient: constrained DAS has no larger scalar joint objective and no larger full-vocabulary joint objective than DIM on both held-out A1 and A2; complement mean-absolute/RMS effects also remain small
opposing_predictions.target_specific_cheat: constrained DAS improves the answer-margin target but loses to DIM on centered full-vocabulary effect fidelity in either held-out family, or its near-zero signed complement hides materially larger absolute/RMS row effects
opposing_predictions.ordinary_overfit: constrained DAS loses to DIM even on the exact scalar objective on either held-out family

predictions.pred_a_authority_axis_and_full_rank_clos: all authorities match, the stored axis is unit norm, and q=I reproduces exact H3 within 1e-4
predictions.pred_b_parent_scalar_aggregates_reproduc: signed subspace and complement fractions reproduce the parent within 0.01
predictions.pred_c_cdas_scalar_objective_dominates_d: constrained-DAS rowwise squared match-plus-complement objective is <= DIM on both held-out A1 and A2
predictions.pred_d_cdas_full_vocabulary_objective_do: constrained-DAS centered full-vocabulary match-plus-complement objective is <= DIM on both held-out A1 and A2
predictions.pred_e_no_signed_cancellation: for each constrained-DAS complement, absolute mean is <=0.30 exact-effect units and no more than 4x the absolute signed mean plus 0.02

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, axis, closure, reproduction, finiteness, or price fails
terminal_rules.screen: C, D, and E all pass: the optimized axis survives the target audit
terminal_rules.null: C fails: the optimized advantage was fit-specific ordinary overfit
terminal_rules.inconclusive: C passes but D or E fails: the answer-margin objective is target-specific or its aggregate report was cancellation-sensitive

interpretation_limits: A scalar answer-margin loss is legitimate for discovering a task-causal quotient, but cannot by itself establish a general H3 feature.
Full-vocabulary fidelity is an independent readout test, not a requirement that a causal feature preserve activation variance.
This audit does not refit either axis and cannot rescue a failed result by changing rank, rows, or penalties.
